text:
Priya: heads-up — we need a routing rule change: prefer x-tenant over Authorization bearer when both present for tenant routing. Current behavior is ambiguous.
Josh: ugh, yeah saw a 503 spike when frontend sent both. Which service?
Priya: api-gateway -> route to customer-specific pool. If x-tenant present should win; otherwise fallback to sub from JWT.
Amanda: Is this for dedicated customers only? We risk exposing tenant spoofing if we trust arbitrary headers.
Dan: security concern: header can be forged unless we only accept upstream-authenticated headers from our edge. We should validate via signed header or mTLS.
Priya: agreed. proposed: accept x-tenant only if signature header x-tenant-sig is present and verifies. Otherwise ignore.
Josh: can we do a lightweight HMAC check? edge signs with key per team.
Sasha: also need UA-based routing for legacy clients — some older SDKs should hit compat model. UA pattern matching is brittle though.
Amanda: maybe add route match on user-agent regex, with lower priority than explicit tenant header; also allow override param ?force_pool for debugging.
Dan: telemetry: we must tag requests with routing_decision so we can split by header vs jwt vs ua.
Infra-bot: deploy queued: feature/tenant-header-routing -> canary on us-west-2 in 10m :deploy:
Josh: rollout UX: add console toggle to enable header fallback per customer; ops should be able to flip without deploy.
Priya: good point — console flag + rollout policy (canary by org) and audit log entries.
Sasha: code snippets:
```json
match: {
  priority: 100,
  header: { name: "x-tenant", verify_sig: true }
}
```
Josh: We'll also need quota attribution mapping: if x-tenant used, bill to tenant; if jwt used, bill to auth-sub; else anonymous.
Amanda: Edge case: proxy chain may add X-Forwarded-For-like duplicates. We should canonicalize header casing and only read first occurrence.
Dan: tests: unit for header precedence, integration with edge signer, load test for UA regex perf.
Priya: Tasks: 1) spec signed header + failure mode 2) console toggle 3) telemetry tag 4) quota mapping 5) tests. I'll file a GH issue.
Josh: lgtm, ping me on the PR. :thumbsup:
Amanda: +1
Infra-bot: canary started: feature/tenant-header-routing on us-west-2 -> 10% traffic
Priya: thanks all, will update issue with links.
